Delete handler with confirm, disabled while in flight, per-post .delete-error on failure, reload on success; errorMessage takes optional action prefix

design_decisions.decision: 204 on success rather than 200 with a body: nothing useful to return
Non-integer id gives 422 (FastAPI default) rather than a custom 404
Use os.remove (not Path.unlink) so patching os.remove simulates failures; catch all exceptions per file
Deletion goes through a basename + resolved-parent check against uploads_dir, same basename convention as _update, rather than trusting stored paths
On success rely on loadLogs/renderLogs resetting `editing`, rather than separate edit cleanup; deleting B while A edits resets A to normal view
Extended errorMessage with an optional prefix instead of a second helper; default keeps existing text

implementation.self_critique: Frontend criteria 10-14 are untested in a browser by me. backend/__pycache__ pre-existed (timestamps older than this run). Path guard on Windows relies on resolve() parent equality.
